scripts.build: npm run build -w @darkscan/rules && prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @darkscan/rules && prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node --import tsx --test test/rules/*.test.ts test/journey/*.test.ts test/evidence/*.test.ts test/report/*.test.ts test/ai/*.test.ts test/security/*.test.ts
